trait.name: Air Form
entries: The elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Thunderous Slam attacks.

action.name: Whirlwind {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, one Medium or smaller creature in the elemental's space. {@actSaveFail} 24 ({@damage 4d10 + 2}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the elemental and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

An air elemental is a funneling cloud of whirling air with a vague semblance of a face. Although it likes to race across the ground, picking up dust and debris as it goes, it can also fly and attack from above.
An air elemental can turn itself into a screaming cyclone, creating a whirlwind that batters creatures even as it flings them away.
